def max_x =  0.8
def min_y = -0.8
def max_y =  0.8

def in_workspace(pose):

            pose[2] >= min_z and pose[2] <= max_z)

# Robot: UR5e, Payload: 1.2 kg, Max TCP speed: 300 mm/s

# -------------------------------------------------
# Configuration
# -------------------------------------------------
set_payload(1.2, [0,0,0.05])          # payload mass and CoM
set_tcp(p[0,0,0.1,0,0,0])            # default TCP offset
set_max_tcp_speed(0.300)             # 300 mm/s safety limit

# Safety zones (confinement & exclusion)
# Confinement zone: keep robot inside a 1 m radius sphere around origin
set_confinement_zone(p[0,0,0,0,0,0], 1.0)
# Exclusion zone: keep robot away from a 0.3 m radius sphere at (0.2, -0.2, 0.2)
set_exclusion_zone(p[0.2,-0.2,0.2,0,0,0], 0.3)

# -------------------------------------------------
# Poses
# -------------------------------------------------
# Joint configuration for Home position
home_joint = [-1.57, -1.57, -1.57, -1.57, 1.57, 0]

# Cartesian waypoints (all in metres)
above_storage   = p[0.5, -0.2, 0.30, 0, 3.14, 0]
pick_position    = p[0.5, -0.2, 0.10, 0, 3.14, 0]
lift_position    = p[0.5, -0.2, 0.30, 0, 3.14, 0]
above_handoff    = p[0.3,  0.4, 0.40, 0, 3.14, 0]
place_position   = p[0.3,  0.4, 0.20, 0, 3.14, 0]
retreat_position = p[0.3,  0.4, 0.50, 0, 3.14, 0]

# -------------------------------------------------
# Speed / Acceleration settings
# -------------------------------------------------
joint_speed      = 0.250   # 250 mm/s → 0.250 m/s
linear_speed_fast = 0.280  # 280 mm/s
linear_speed_slow = 0.120  # 120 mm/s
linear_speed_mid  = 0.200  # 200 mm/s
linear_speed_mid2 = 0.250  # 250 mm/s

joint_acceleration = 1.2   # rad/s² (default)
cartesian_acceleration = 1.2 # m/s² (default)

# -------------------------------------------------
# Hybrid (Force) Mode definition
# -------------------------------------------------
# Force mode will be active while descending to pick and while placing.
# Selection vector: [Fx, Fy, Fz, Tx, Ty, Tz] → we control force in Z only.
selection_vector = [0,0,1,0,0,0]
# Desired wrench (force) – 5 N downwards for pick, 5 N upwards for place.
wrench_pick  = [0,0,-5,0,0,0]
wrench_place = [0,0, 5,0,0,0]
# Type 2 → Cartesian impedance (position + force)
force_type = 2
# Limits for the force mode (max deviation in each DOF)
force_limits = [0.02,0.02,0.02, 0.1,0.1,0.1]

# -------------------------------------------------
# Program
# -------------------------------------------------
def main():
    # 1) Move to Home (joint space)
    set_joint_acceleration(joint_acceleration)
    movej(home_joint, a=joint_acceleration, v=joint_speed)

    # 2) Move above storage bin (linear, fast)
    set_cartesian_impedance([2000,2000,2000,200,200,200])  # stiff for transport
    movel(above_storage, a=cartesian_acceleration, v=linear_speed_fast)

    # 3) Descend to pick (hybrid force control, slow)
    # Activate force mode before the descent
    force_mode(above_storage, selection_vector, wrench_pick, force_type, force_limits)
    movel(pick_position, a=cartesian_acceleration, v=linear_speed_slow)
    # Release force mode after contact is made
    end_force_mode()

    # 4) Lift from bin (linear, medium speed)
    movel(lift_position, a=cartesian_acceleration, v=linear_speed_mid)

    # 5) Transit to handoff zone (linear, fast)
    movel(above_handoff, a=cartesian_acceleration, v=linear_speed_mid2)

    # 6) Descend to place (hybrid force control, slow)
    force_mode(above_handoff, selection_vector, wrench_place, force_type, force_limits)
    movel(place_position, a=cartesian_acceleration, v=linear_speed_slow)
    end_force_mode()

    # 7) Retreat from handoff zone (linear, medium speed)
    movel(retreat_position, a=cartesian_acceleration, v=linear_speed_mid)

    # 8) Return to Home (joint space)
    movej(home_joint, a=joint_acceleration, v=joint_speed)

    # Program finished – keep robot in stop mode
    stopj(2)

# -------------------------------------------------
# Helper: End force mode safely
# -------------------------------------------------
def end_force_mode():
    # Switch back to normal Cartesian impedance
    set_cartesian_impedance([1500,1500,1500,150,150,150])
    # Small pause to ensure mode change
    sleep(0.1)

# -------------------------------------------------
# Run
# -------------------------------------------------
main()
